name: Mom’s Nutrimix - Vanilla (400G)
subtitle: Clean Protein | Sustained Energy | Zero Added Sugar

ingredients.name: Calcium
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Dairy foods. Fruits, Leafy vegetables etc.

Amount: 500mg (50% RDA)

 Our nutritionists say: Calcium is a must for every mother over 30. Absorption of calcium becomes difficult with age and highly common deficiency of Vitamin D3 leading to weak bones and muscle pain.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Oranges, Amla, Strawberry etc.

Form: Ascorbic acid

Amount: 35 mg (53% RDA)

Our nutritionists say: Vitamin C helps wounds heal, boosts the immune system, and keeps infections at bay. Moreover, it is also seen to reduce cholesterol in body.

ingredients.name: Biotin
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Avocados, Nuts, Egg Yolk, Mushrooms etc.

Amount: 35 mg (87% RDA)

Our nutritionists say: Biotin is the vitamin which helps produce keratin (protein responsible for forming nails, skin and hair). It increases hair growth and even helps promote younger & youthful skin

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, meats, milk, egg yolk etc.

Form: Cyanocobalamin

Amount: 1.1 mcg (50% RDA)

Our nutritionists say: Vitamin B12 is a supermineral. It turns food into energy, which in turn fuels brain development and growth. Most natural B12 is found in animal sources and this is especially good for vegetarians and vegans!

ingredients.name: Vitamin A
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Carrots, Green leafy vegetables and Eggs

Form: Retinol palmitate

Amount: 450 mg

Our nutritionists says: Around here we have a saying: Vitamin A keeps the eye-doctors away! Eyes need this vitamin to heal themselves and reduce weakening of eyes with age.

ingredients.name: Ragi
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: Ragi is a household name in India. Known for its high calcium and protein content, ragi is the perfect grain to mix into your kid's foods for maximum health.

ingredients.name: Bajra
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: High in iron and rich in dietary fibers, bajra is an Indian millet superfood that reduces long term illnesses and is packed with nutrients, vitamins and minerals.

ingredients.name: Almond Powder
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: Almonds are one of the best plant-based protein sources out there. Packed with nutrients, almonds are rich in Vitamin E, magnesium and essential fatty acids, keeping you happy and healthy.

ingredients.name: Walnut Powder
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: You may think we're nuts for suggesting this but walnuts actually have incredibly high nutritional content. Filled with omega-3 fatty acids, walnuts help boost memory, concentration and overall cognitive behaviour.

ingredients.name: Oats Fiber
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: The prevalence of childhood constipation can be as high as 29.6%. Studies indicate that oat bran, the fiber-rich outer layer of the grain, may help relieve constipation and may reduce the use of laxatives. It also promotes healthy gut bacteria and naturally slows digestion - increasing feelings of fullness.

ingredients.name: Brown Rice Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Brown Rice

Our pediatricians say:The complex carbohydrates in brown rice promote feelings of satiation, keeping kids’ tummies full and happy. Brown rice contains a whole host of micronutrients that are useful in helping kids’ body and brain develop.

ingredients.name: Pea Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Pea

Our pediatricians say: The peas that your kids are constantly trying to avoid? They're actually complete sources of protein so the more peas your kids eat, the hap-pea-er they’ll be!

ingredients.name: Moong Dal Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Moong Dal

Our pediatricians say: Moong dal is considered to be one of the best plant-based sources of protein and can do wonders for your kid's hair, skin, nails and growth. The folate in moong dal boosts bone marrow and brain function.

ingredients.name: Flax Seeds
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: Unless you're a fish, your body can't make omega-3. No problem. Flax seed is one of the richest vegan sources of essential omega-3. This fatty acid not only acts as an antioxidant to prevent disease, but it is used by the body to promote healthy cell growth and brain function.

description:
🌟 Strength & Recovery, Made Simple For Moms

Motherhood is beautiful, but it can take a toll on you. Constant fatigue, aching bones, and hormonal dips aren’t just “being tired.” They’re signs your body needs more than what a regular diet can offer.

This clean, daily nutrition drink is designed just for moms, to rebuild strength, restore energy, and help you feel more like you.

What’s inside 2 scoops?
✅ 12gm Protein -  Rebuilds strength, supports recovery
✅ 24 Essential Vitamins & Minerals -  Helps bridge nutrient gaps
✅ Calcium + Vitamin D3 - Supports bone strength
✅ DHA (Omega-3) -  Supports memory & focus
✅ Prebiotics + Probiotics Fibre -  Good for gut & metabolism 

The Clean Label Promise 🌱
✔️ No added sugar • No maltodextrin or fillers
✔️ No artificials • No side effects
✔️ Lab-tested • Nutritionist-approved

Made for Moms 💛
Just add 2 scoops in 200 ml of milk, water or blend into your favourite smoothie and enjoy !

Two scoops won’t change everything. But two scoops, every day? That’s the magic to upgrade your ✨

Mix 2 scoops (34 grams) of Mom's Nutrimix with 200 ml of milk or water, shake and drink or blend into your smoothie.

Kindly Note: This is meant for immediate consumption and should be had in hot or cold milk. Do not boil the milk after adding Nutrimix powder.

reviews.author: Meera S.
reviews.title: Delicious and comforting!
reviews.body: This has become my go-to on busy mornings. I add it to milk or a smoothie and it tastes really good without being too sweet. It keeps me feeling satisfied for hours and blends super smoothly every time.

reviews.author: Riya K.
reviews.title: Nutrition powder that actually fits in my day
reviews.body: I never realized how much protein I was missing until I started paying attention. This makes it so easy to add protein to my breakfast or smoothie without overthinking it. It tastes good, blends well, and keeps me feeling full and steady through the day.

reviews.author: Ritika M.
reviews.title: Feels more like a treat than a supplement
reviews.body: I usually forget powders, but the vanilla flavour makes this so enjoyable. I’ve used it in smoothies and even plain milk. It feels comforting and nourishing at the same time.

reviews.author: Neha J.
reviews.title: My everyday nutrition fix
reviews.body: I didn’t expect to enjoy the taste this much. The subtle vanilla flavour works with almost anything. It’s become part of my daily routine because it’s easy, comforting, and doesn’t feel forced at all.

reviews.author: Kavita M.
reviews.title: So easy to add to my routine
reviews.body: I love how effortless this is to use. I just mix it into my regular smoothie or a glass of milk and I’m done. No prep, no mess, just an easy way to add nutrition without changing what I already eat.
